now.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
now.text: Logan fights wars beside Victor and later quits Team X. He becomes Weapon X, then loses his memory to an adamantium bullet.
cases: FX-009 The Battle of Three Mile Island (X-Men Origins: Wolverine)

proposed.text: Logan fights wars beside Victor and later quits Team X. He becomes Weapon X, then loses his memory when Stryker shoots him in the head with adamantium bullets.

changes.evidence: X-Men Origins: Wolverine: Stryker shoots Logan in the head with two adamantium bullets (plural), which wipes his memory; the record says a single bullet.

now.title: X-Men (2000)
now.text: A cage fighter in Canada, Logan saves Rogue from Sabretooth and joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.

proposed.text: A cage fighter in Canada, Logan is saved with Rogue from Sabretooth by Cyclops and Storm. He joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.

changes.evidence: X-Men (2000): Sabretooth ambushes Logan and Rogue on the road and throws Logan aside; Cyclops and Storm arrive, blast Sabretooth and save them both. Logan does not save Rogue from Sabretooth.
